changelog: **Sales board shows only the viewer's own book (#3755):** `/sales/board` listed what `GET /api/mentorship` lets the role read (the whole tenant for an ORG_ADMIN/OBSERVER) while `/sales/leads/[id]` opened only `mentorId = self`, so a colleague's card was listed and its click was a 404. One rule now, `salesBookWhere()` / `salesBookScope()` (`src/lib/salesBookRule.ts`, `src/lib/salesBook.ts`): own records for everybody, an ADMIN included; the whole tenant only for the sales dispatcher. The lead page and `GET /api/mentorship?surface=sales` (narrow-only; without it the admin surfaces keep their scope) read it, and the sales board asks with it. The admin board still opens the admin detail.

en: The sales board now shows only your own leads (a dispatcher still sees the whole team's), so every card you see opens. Admins see everyone's leads on the admin board.
tr: Satış panosu artık yalnızca sizin müşteri adaylarınızı gösteriyor (dağıtıcı hâlâ tüm ekibinkini görür); gördüğünüz her kart açılıyor. Yöneticiler herkesin adaylarını yönetici panosunda görür.
de: Das Vertriebsboard zeigt jetzt nur noch Ihre eigenen Leads (die Dispositionsrolle sieht weiterhin die des ganzen Teams), sodass sich jede Karte öffnen lässt. Admins sehen alle Leads auf dem Admin-Board.
